correctness.rationale: For all n>=3, fixed states have maximal independent rim zero sets; known exact z count is reweighted using B(u) over pair states 01,10,11 with characteristic t³-ut-u. Primitive B(1) has dominant rho; analytic continuation lambda(e^t) yields log MGF = n(log lambda(e^t)-log rho)+O(theta0^n), with first and second derivatives mu and v>0. Characteristic functions yield normal limit and differentiated errors give o(1) moment corrections; optimum states grow at most linearly versus total 2rho^n. Independent direct n3-13 state enumeration matched histogram.
